annotation_method: Coding agent visually placed palm/finger/object and placement-contact rectangles in native RGB keyframes, then piecewise linear offline interpolation. Active roles change at manually judged contact/transport intervals. No detector or tracker; not independently reviewed human ground truth. Keyframes and midpoints reviewed, not every original frame.
revision_reason: Follow active left hand during fruit transport instead of retaining passive right hand in the tight ROI; preserve original 258 preview frames.
availability_policy: Interpolated boundary keys retain the latest parent source keyframe; available_at is not reset to the new boundary frame.
